map.每日允许摄入量 ADI 以每千克体重计：摄入量(mg) = 食品量(g) × 添: The acceptable daily intake (ADI) is given per kilogram of body weight. Intake (mg) = food amount (g) × additive concentration (mg/kg) ÷ 1000; intake per kg of body weight = intake ÷ weight (kg); percentage of ADI = intake per kg ÷ ADI × 100%. Below 50% is safe, 50% to 100% needs attention and above 100% exceeds the limit. Compound additives are assessed by summing each share of ADI.

map.苯甲酸 ADI 0–5 mg/kg·bw；60kg 成人日允许 = 5×60 =: The ADI for benzoic acid is 0 to 5 mg/kg body weight, so a 60 kg adult can take 5×60 = 300 mg per day. If actual intake is 90 mg, then %ADI = 90/300×100% = 30%, which is safe, while reaching 300 mg hits the 100% ceiling.
map.多种含同 ADI 物质（如不同防腐剂）分别算摄入求和，总暴露超 ADI×体重即风: For multiple substances sharing an ADI, such as different preservatives, compute each intake and sum them; if total exposure exceeds ADI × body weight there is a risk, so the formula or the dosage needs adjusting.
map.每日允许摄入量，指终身每日摄入不致健康风险的量（mg/kg 体重）；%ADI<1: The acceptable daily intake is the amount that does not pose a health risk when consumed every day for a lifetime (mg/kg body weight). %ADI below 100% is generally considered safe.
map.用各食品该添加剂最大使用量×消费量求和；合规产品通常在 ADI 内，超量多为长期: Sum the maximum permitted usage of that additive in each food × the amount consumed. Compliant products usually stay within the ADI, and excess usually comes from long-term heavy consumption of a single food.
